claims.text: The Random Kitchen Sink (RKS) approach is used for offensive language detection and other NLP tasks.
RKS explicitly maps embedding vectors to a dimension where the data becomes linearly separable.
The RKS method provides an approximate kernel function via explicit mapping.
The RKS approach has shown improved results in classification tasks.
